units.source_text: 她咬着我的耳朵详细地诉说着柏木的不良行为、过火的卑劣行径的细节，

en.t: She whispered into my ear in detail about Kashiwagi's misconduct and the particulars of his excessive, despicable acts,

units.source_text: 可是所有这些只有"人生"二字在我的耳边回响。

en.t: but out of all this, only the two words "human life" echoed in my ears.

units.source_text: 他的残忍性、有计划的手段、背叛、冷酷、向女人强要钱的种种手腕，

en.t: His cruelty, his calculated methods, his betrayals, his coldness, and all the ways he forced money out of women,

units.source_text: 这一切只不过是解释了他难以言喻的扭力而已。

en.t: all of it merely explained the indescribable twisting force within him.

units.source_text: 而我只要相信他对他自己的X型的腿的诚实性就足矣。

en.t: And for me, it was enough simply to believe in his honesty toward his own X-shaped legs.
